key_results: FIA-LLM reduces RMSE by 8.6% vs baseline; improves AUC by 1.2 percentage points (p<0.01); ICC=0.83 for human-LLM label agreement
comments: Dual-stream architecture addresses self-referential supervision risk cleverly but external validation on non-ASSISTments platforms and diverse student populations needed.

model_io.model: FIA-LLM (Confidence-Aware Robust Distillation + Feedback Intervention Attention + Joint Structured Decoding)
inputs: Behavioral histories; feedback proxies; 2,000 human annotations + LLM pseudo-labels
outputs: Learning state (SDT-grounded), next-item achievement, SDT dimension, diagnostic explanation

hypotheses.hypothesis: Feedback-conditioned learning states improve achievement prediction beyond behavioral histories alone
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; FIA mechanism and JSD architecture yield lower RMSE and higher AUC

title: Computational and experimental screening identifies 6-chloro-2-hydroxy-1-naphthaldehyde derivatives as disruptors of the HEG1–KRIT1 protein–protein interaction
task: Identify small-molecule disruptors of HEG1–KRIT1 protein–protein interaction via computational and experimental screening
key_results: HN1 achieved IC₅₀ 3.51 ± 0.14 µM in bead-based assay; docking/MD simulations indicated ligand occupancy of HEG1-recognition region; modest ΔΔGPPI estimates
comments: Numerical IC₅₀ differences (HN1 vs HN2/HN3) not rigorously compared; modest free-energy estimates and micromolar potency indicate preliminary hit requiring cellular validation.

model_io.model: AutoDock Vina + 1000ns MD simulation + MM/PBSA + bead-based flow cytometry competition assay
outputs: Top candidates with binding free energies; IC₅₀ estimates for PPI disruption

hypotheses.hypothesis: Computational screening identifies HEG1–KRIT1 disruptors validated by experimental PPI competition assay
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; HN1 shows concentration-dependent inhibition; computational rankings correlate with experimental IC₅₀

title: Sequence fidelity of large language models in trauma primary survey: a comparative in silico study of spontaneous xABCDE-consistent prioritisation
task: Evaluate sequence fidelity of large language models in trauma primary survey prioritization
key_results: Sequence disorder in 72.7% of queries (95% CI 65.0–79.2); no model placed haemorrhage control first despite being critical; high inter-run agreement (κ=0.873)
comments: Critical safety finding for clinical LLM deployment; small case set (n=10) limits generalizability and may not capture full range of trauma presentations.

model_io.model: GPT-4.1-mini vs Gemini 2.5 Flash vs Claude Haiku 4.5
inputs: 10 polytrauma cases; 5 prompt conditions; request for 6 clinical actions
outputs: Sequence of actions (ordered/disordered relative to xABCDE protocol)

hypotheses.hypothesis: LLMs spontaneously generate trauma actions in xABCDE-consistent order without explicit algorithm mention
hypotheses.result: Refuted; 72.7% showed sequence disorder; haemorrhage control deprioritized

title: Semantic image retrieval using deep feature representation, LDA, and extreme gradient boosting
task: Content-based image retrieval using deep features, LDA, and gradient boosting
key_results: mAP@20: 96.40% (Corel-1K), 85.00% (Corel-5K), 93.72% (Corel-1500), 83.96% (OTScene); avg retrieval time 0.34s
comments: Closed-set evaluation on benchmark datasets; open-set and cross-domain generalization untested; modest novelty in combining existing methods.

model_io.model: VGG-16 + LDA + XGBoost + cosine similarity ranking
outputs: Ranked list of Top-20 similar images

hypotheses.hypothesis: Supervised discriminant compression, nonlinear guidance, and similarity ranking provide complementary benefits
hypotheses.result: Ablation confirmed; binomial sign test p=0.0078

title: NCOA1 and PRPS1 as novel metabolism-related biomarkers in myocardial ischemia–reperfusion injury
task: Identify metabolism-related biomarkers in myocardial ischemia-reperfusion injury
key_results: NCOA1 and PRPS1 identified as candidate biomarkers with opposing expression patterns; correlated with M0 macrophage infiltration; docking predicted interactions with methylthioninium and thioguanine
comments: Computational predictions (docking scores 'moderate') not experimentally validated; RT-qPCR validation limited to independent GEO cohorts without clinical tissue samples.

outputs: Candidate biomarkers (NCOA1, PRPS1) with predicted drug interactions

hypotheses.hypothesis: Mitochondrial metabolism genes distinguish MIRI from controls and associate with immune infiltration
hypotheses.result: NCOA1/PRPS1 validated in independent cohorts; correlated with M0 macrophages

title: Identification of esculin as a direct modulator of IGF1 in cervical cancer with integrated computational and experimental studies
task: Identify and validate IGF1 direct modulators for cervical cancer via integrated computational-experimental approach
key_results: Esculin identified as top IGF1-binding compound with altered conformational dynamics; dose-dependent cytotoxicity in HeLa cells (p<0.001); reduced intracellular IGF1 levels
comments: Strong computational-experimental integration but limited to in vitro validation; in vivo efficacy and mechanism of IGF1 release/degradation remain unclear.

model_io.model: Molecular docking + MD simulation (500ns) + ADMET + PASS prediction + experimental validation
outputs: Top candidate binders with binding free energies; validated IGF1 modulation

hypotheses.hypothesis: Esculin and rotenone are top IGF1-binding candidates with favorable pharmacokinetics
hypotheses.result: Esculin confirmed as direct IGF1 modulator with cytotoxic effect; rotenone showed minimal antiproliferative effect

title: Deep learning–based object detection for automated classification of ripe and unripe tomatoes in field conditions

key_results: YOLO26s: macro-AP 0.741, ROC AUC 0.954; Faster R-CNN: macro-AP 0.241, ROC AUC 0.836; localization is main bottleneck
comments: Small dataset (367 images, 8,900 annotations) from single greenhouse; crop-specific models may not transfer to other tomato varieties or lighting conditions.

model_io.model: YOLO26s vs Faster R-CNN (ResNet-50 FPN)

hypotheses.hypothesis: YOLO single-stage detector outperforms Faster R-CNN two-stage under strict localization thresholds

title: Phase aligned EEG source space features for distinguishing Alzheimer’s disease from frontotemporal dementia
task: Differential diagnosis of Alzheimer's disease vs frontotemporal dementia using EEG
key_results: 94.21% accuracy (AD vs FTD) and 90.63% accuracy (FTD vs CN) using phase-aligned source-space features

title: Evaluating the quality of consumer health information across the web, large language models, and search engines: a review of criteria, instruments, and methods
task: Evaluate quality of consumer health information across web, LLMs, and search engines
key_results: No consensus on evaluation criteria or standardized framework; substantial variation in accuracy, readability, reliability, medical adequacy dimensions; LLM-generated content lacks established assessment tools
comments: Narrative review identifies fragmentation but proposes no novel methodology; lack of empirical quality comparisons across platforms limits actionable guidance.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Traditional health information quality criteria generalize to LLM-generated content
hypotheses.result: Refuted; identified limitations in applying conventional tools to AI-generated information

title: Chatbot rating scale (CHARS): Development and validation of a new tool for assessing the quality of health and social care chatbots
task: Development and psychometric validation of Chatbot Rating Scale (CHARS) for health chatbots
key_results: Modified Delphi process (24 experts, 3 rounds) yielded 25-item scale; 979 participants evaluated 36 chatbots; factorial analysis confirmed 3-factor structure (Design, Interactive User Experience, Functionality); Cronbach's alpha 0.88–0.90; factor loadings 0.77–0.87 with ICC 0.88–0.98 (all p<0.001)
comments: Rigorous psychometric development with diverse expert and user participation, but internal consistency and interrater reliability do not establish criterion or predictive validity for actual user engagement or health outcomes.

model_io.model: Chatbot Rating Scale (CHARS) with 5-point Likert scale

hypotheses.hypothesis: CHARS three-factor structure (Design, IUX, Functionality) explains observed variation in chatbot quality ratings
hypotheses.result: Confirmed via EFA/CFA; excellent internal consistency (α 0.88–0.90) and interrater reliability (ICC 0.88–0.98)

title: Explainable multimodal learning analytics for model-based counterfactual decision support using literature-calibrated synthetic data
task: Explainable student risk prediction with counterfactual decision support
key_results: XGBoost achieved 80.7% accuracy, 0.828 F1, 0.905 ROC-AUC with sentiment; logistic regression best ROC-AUC 0.930; constrained greedy counterfactual search reduced risk score by mean 33.3 pp for 46.3% of cases; 5-fold cross-validation ROC-AUC 0.929 for best configuration
comments: Comprehensive evaluation of synthetic framework with useful ablations, but authors explicitly acknowledge lack of educational validity, causal effectiveness, and deployment readiness—limiting real-world applicability.

model_io.model: XGBoost + Logistic Regression + Random Forest

hypotheses.hypothesis: Sentiment features improve prediction performance vs. LMS indicators alone

hypotheses.hypothesis: Greedy counterfactual search outperforms DiCE-random by runtime
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; greedy ~4x faster but model-dependent (XGBoost 53.7% threshold crossing vs. RF 41.4%)

model_io.model: FoundationPose (6D object pose estimation)

title: Quantum resources for everlasting communication security

key_results: Loss control-based QKD achieves everlasting security without relying solely on no-cloning or Bell inequalities; security framework integrates physical assumptions with formal proofs; channel-dependent QKD defined as new protocol class

hypotheses.hypothesis: Loss control-based QKD maintains everlasting security with additional quantum effects beyond traditional principles

key_results: Ensemble model (CNN-BiLSTM-Attention + Transformer + XGBoost meta-learner) outperformed individual models in RMSE, MAE, R², MAPE, NRMSE; achieved higher accuracy and stability for extreme rainfall events; uncertainty quantification via Monte Carlo dropout
comments: Solid ensemble approach with good interpretability via attention mechanisms, but missing quantitative performance benchmarks and comparison to operational weather forecast models.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Ensemble of multiple deep learning architectures outperforms individual models for extreme rainfall prediction

title: Modeling and optimization of high-temperature degradation in fuze coil springs using response surface methodology

key_results: Cubic RSM models achieved R² > 96% for permanent deformation and stress relaxation; optimal condition identified at 120.4 °C and 1.10 h with predicted responses of 8.14% and 13.82%; independent confirmation tests showed ≤ 8.8% error

model_io.model: Cubic Response Surface Methodology

title: Exact nonlinear wave structures in the conformable time-fractional Vakhnenko equation via bilinear neural networks
